description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'LoaderCursor' demonstrating the use of CursorLoader to load and display contacts in a fragment, including search filtering functionality.

classes.name: LoaderCursor
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating contact loading with CursorLoader and search filtering.

classes.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying a list of contacts with search filter, using CursorLoader.

classes.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment.MySearchView
classes.description: Custom SearchView that clears text when collapsed.

methods.name: LoaderCursor.onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the contact list fragment.

methods.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment.onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up the list adapter, initializes loader, and prepares search view.

methods.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment.onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates search menu item with custom SearchView.

methods.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment.onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles search text change, updates filter, and restarts loader.

methods.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment.onClose
methods.description: Clears search query when search view is closed.

methods.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment.onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates CursorLoader based on current filter.

methods.name: LoaderCursor.CursorLoaderListFragment.onLoadFinished
methods.description: Swaps in new cursor data and shows list.
